strictPolicy: Accepted evidence must be a native post or native comment authored by a real person listed in src/lib/social/top-voices.ts.
Organization accounts, company accounts, and company reposts are not insiders or partners.
Accepted evidence must expose a stable native post/comment URL plus visible metrics.
The listed person's native visible text, or visible native quote/reply context, must mention the target company, founder, official handle, or domain.
Profiles, search pages, profile snippets, likes-only activity, inferred engagement, and posts authored by founders thanking a top voice are rejected.
Exact sourceUrl or platformPostId values already present in src/lib/social/targeted-evidence-current.json are rejected as duplicates.
